# RTC Portal — State Road Transport Corporation Directory

> Public transportation enquiry directory, station master contact numbers, and intercity bus route schedules across Indian state transport corporations: UPSRTC (Uttar Pradesh), MSRTC (Maharashtra), RSRTC (Rajasthan), Haryana Roadways, HRTC (Himachal Pradesh), UTC (Uttarakhand), and PUNBUS / PRTC (Punjab).

All telephone numbers and station desks are compiled directly from published records of the respective state corporations (.gov.in public disclosures). Each depot page provides tap-to-call enquiry desk numbers, station master offices, and 24x7 statewide customer service helplines.

## State Directories
- [State RTCs Overview](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/states)
- [National Intercity Timetables](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/timetables)
- [Emergency & Highway Helplines (112, NHAI 1033)](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/emergency)

### State Hubs
- [Uttar Pradesh — UPSRTC Bus Stand Directory & Routes](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/uttar-pradesh)
- [Maharashtra — MSRTC ST Stand Enquiry & Timetables](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/maharashtra)
- [Rajasthan — RSRTC Roadways Bus Stand Contacts](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/rajasthan)
- [Haryana — Haryana Roadways Depots & Time Table](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/haryana)
- [Himachal Pradesh — HRTC Himachal Roadways Contacts](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/himachal-pradesh)
- [Uttarakhand — UTC Roadways Station Master Desks](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/uttarakhand)
- [Punjab — PUNBUS & PRTC Enquiry Directory](https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/punjab)

## URL Structure
- Depot Contact Page: `https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/{state-slug}/{city}-bus-station-contact-number` (e.g., `/uttar-pradesh/kanpur-bus-station-contact-number`)
- Intercity Route Timetable: `https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/{state-slug}/routes/{origin}-to-{destination}-bus-time-table` (e.g., `/maharashtra/routes/pune-to-mumbai-bus-time-table`)
- State Routes Index: `https://rtc.shivrajsinh.in/{state-slug}/routes`

## Sourcing & Attribution
- Uttar Pradesh: upsrtc.up.gov.in
- Maharashtra: msrtc.maharashtra.gov.in
- Rajasthan: transport.rajasthan.gov.in/rsrtc
- Haryana: hartrans.gov.in
- Himachal Pradesh: hrtchp.com
- Uttarakhand: utconline.uk.gov.in
- Punjab: punbusonline.com
